edges.notes: getUserIdFromName: tryGetRequest("username", params). tryGetRequest (line 30) appends the query and calls tryRequest, whose fetch("/api/" + url, { method }) (line 20) is the helper's inner request, so each tryGetRequest/tryPostRequest call is the call site. The base is the page's own origin: in dev Vite (client/vite.config.ts) proxies /api to http://127.0.0.1:8080 (the server's PORT fallback, server/src/index.ts:61) unless VITE_USE_PROXY=true points it at the deployed site; in prod the same Express app serves client/build. Every route is registered directly on app in server/src/index.ts with its full /api path (no routers, no mounts)

fetch(wasmUrl), wasmUrl a Vite ?url import of the bundled .wasm file: a static asset (served by express.static from client/build), not a route

Generated wasm-bindgen glue (committed JS): the __wbg_fetch import calls fetch(getObject(arg0)) with a URL or Request handed over by the Rust player at runtime (map and bot downloads), so neither the URL nor the method is known statically. Labeled like the generated swagger clients: committed source, whatever wrote it

__wbg_init's fetch(module_or_path): the default is new URL('…_bg.wasm', import.meta.url) (line 4139), a bundled static asset, not a route. Both callers (components/Replays.tsx:515, playback/mapAssetWorker.ts:7) pass a compiled WebAssembly.Module, so no caller supplies a URL
